products.description: Toner restores your skin’s natural pH after washing.
details: Toner restores your skin’s natural pH after washing. This helps your skin stay balanced and healthy. It removes leftover oil, makeup, and residue. This reduces clogged pores and breakouts. Toner smooths the look of pores. Your skin looks more even. Hydrating toners add moisture and reduce dryness. Soothing toners calm redness and irritation. Exfoliating toners remove dead skin cells and boost glow. Oil controlling toners reduce shine and help prevent acne. Toner helps serums and moisturizers absorb better. You get better results with less product. Use toner daily after cleansing. Choose alcohol free formulas that match your skin type.Oil-controlling
